resume.summary: Generative AI developer who built and evaluated a RAG support chatbot with LangChain and FastAPI. 5 months of internship experience shipping Python LLM services, from the retrieval pipeline to groundedness evaluation, plus a containerised FastAPI project deployed through CI/CD.

bullets.text: Built a RAG pipeline over 1,200 internal support documents with LangChain and FastAPI, cutting average answer lookup time from 6 minutes to under 1 minute.
Measured answer quality before release with an evaluation script that scored 150 question-answer pairs for groundedness and caught 18 hallucinated answers.
Wrote the prompt templates used by the support assistant.
Built a FastAPI service that answers questions over uploaded PDFs using embeddings stored in a vector database (PostgreSQL with pgvector).
Containerised the service with Docker and deployed it through a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline.
Contributed to a Python script that ranks resumes against a job description using sentence-transformer embeddings.
